lines.text: Every idea deserves to be seen.
We're Exenova — designers, developers and filmmakers, under one roof.
We shoot it. We draw it. We design it.
From exhibits and music videos, to short films and full brand identities.
Brand and graphic design. Web development. Film and video. Interactive and games. UI and UX.
One team. One point of contact.
And we build the platforms too — fast, accessible, and easy to run.
Meet the people behind the work: Shan, Justine, Rei, and Orlando.
